level: high

description: Detects service accounts authenticating from non-registered IP addresses, indicative of credential theft or Golden Ticket attacks.

rule GoldenTicket_TGT_Metadata {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Golden Ticket artifacts in Kerberos TGT metadata"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1558.001"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = "krbtgt" wide ascii
        $b = "PAC_SIGNATURE" wide ascii
        $c = "forwardable" wide ascii
        $d = "renewable" wide ascii
        $e = "tgtLifetime" fullword ascii
    condition:
        all of ($a, $b, $c, $d) and $e == 10
}

rule GoldenTicket_TGT_Metadata {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Golden Ticket artifacts in Kerberos TGT metadata"

        $c = "forwardable" wide ascii
        $d = "renewable" wide ascii
        $e = "tgtLifetime" fullword ascii
    condition:
        all of ($a, $b, $c, $d) and $e == 10
}
